**Note 1:** This schema uses the *European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer (EORTC)* staging system. 

**Note 2:**  Laterality must be coded for C441-C443 and C445-C447.  For codes C443 and C445, if the tumor is midline (e.g., chin), code 5 (midline) in the laterality field.

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Mycosis Fungoides/Sezary Disease of Skin, Vulva, Penis, Scrotum* chapter on page 182 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=182).
